itinerary-7days.name: 7 Days in Singapore (Complete Experience)
itinerary-7days.title: Enjoy Singapore in 7 Days: Adventurous Travel Itinerary

tiles.title: Highlight 1
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAn iconic district in Singapore, that\u0027s guaranteed to bombard your senses, with a mix of nature, arts and shopping, there\u0027s something for everyone.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 2
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSpend the day marveling at the flora on display at the Flower Dome, and exploring the mist-filled landscape of the Cloud Forest.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 3
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExplore floors of luxury retailers, with the largest collection of coveted designer boutiques in Asia.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 4
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBreak for lunch - dig into fresh and springy noodles and enjoy a beloved hawker staple at this popular establishment.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 5
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eCalling all art enthusiasts, this beloved lotus-inspired establishment blurs the lines between art, science, culture and technology, with exciting exhibitions on rotation.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 6
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTake a stroll over to snap photos of our city’s most famous icon, the Merlion - with a body of a fish and the head of a lion.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 7
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWith its charming colonial architecture and bustling atmosphere, relish in this restored Victorian food market that offers a quintessential taste of Singapore.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 8
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eEnd the night off with a mug of artisanal beer and award-winning rooftop dining concept at the world’s highest microbrewery with a stunning view of Marina Bay.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 9
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003ePerched on the 57th floor of Marina Bay Sands, savour signature cocktails while taking in the stunning city views from the top.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 10
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSun, sand and surf await you on your second day. Located off our city\u0027s southern shore, Sentosa island is known for its white beaches and family-friendly activities.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 11
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExperience the magic of the movies at this theme park, home to a host of exhilarating rides, spread across six movie-themed districts from Hollywood to The Lost World.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 12
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAlternatively, embark on an odyssey beneath the waves and find captivating species from the deep, including Atlantic Sea Nettles, Fried Egg Sea Jellies and more.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 13
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eEach of Sentosa\u0027s beaches possess their own unique charms, from tranquil Tanjong Beach to the hustle and bustle of Siloso Beach.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 14
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAlternatively, find delectable dishes like curry debal and buah keluak fried rice at this restaurant serving up authentic Eurasian fare.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 15
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWith a floating aqua park, an indoor electric go-kart arena, mini-golf and more, this beach side wonderland promises fun for the entire family.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 16
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eDine and sail on an evening cruise with Royal Albatross, or lunch at the Albatross Island Restaurant in the Southern Islands, reachable by Albatross speedboats from Marina South Pier, Resorts World Sentosa, or Ola Beach Club.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 17
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTravel to and from Sentosa in style, with stunning aerial views on board the Singapore Cable Car.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 18
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eEnd your day at this stunning waterfront view mall that offers a plethora of retail, entertainment, and lifestyle experiences.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 19
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSingapore’s rich colonial history and bright future intertwine in the Civic District, where museums and colonial buildings sit alongside skyscrapers.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 20
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExplore our city\u0027s culture and heritage at this grand old dame of a local museum, where history comes to life.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 21
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHoused in buildings that were once our country\u0027s City Hall and Supreme Court, National Gallery Singapore boasts over 8,000 works of art.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 22
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExplore Bugis, a district with a colourful past now known for its trendy stores. Find great bargains and more at Bugis Street Market.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 23
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eMake a beeline for the ethnic enclave Little India, and tuck into mouth-watering South Indian food such as popular local delicacy fish head curry at Banana Leaf Apolo.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 24
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eItching for more shopping options? check out Mustafa Centre – a shopping complex that sells just about everything you can think of.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 25
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSingapore\u0027s largest cathedral is a stellar example of colonial-era architecture and heritage.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 26
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eFormerly a Catholic convent, this timeless landmark is now home to various restaurants and cafes like Whitegrass, New Ubin Seafood and The Glasshouse.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 27
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eDon\u0027t forget to swing by this legendary colonial-style hotel which exudes timeless elegance, as well as the Long Bar.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 28
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eMake your way to Northern Singapore to ignite your love for nature with the majestic animals, nature-themed attractions and lush greenery at Mandai.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 29
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHome to over 3,500 birds, be immersed in naturalistic walk-through aviaries that reflect different habitats of the world.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 30
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExperience the wonders of wildlife from the furry and adorable to the ferocious and majestic, the animals of the Singapore Zoo are a sight to behold.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 31
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003ePlay, dine or enjoy a quick respite from your wildlife adventure, from the towering waterfall upon arrival to the interactive play areas.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 32
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eDig into a four-course dinner in Singapore\u0027s largest Tipi Tent and embark on a tram ride to discover the mysterious creatures of the night.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 33
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAs night falls, head over to the world’s first-ever park for nocturnal animals and embark on walking trails.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 34
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTake in the sights and sounds of Chinatown, and head to the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Masjid Jamae Mosque and Sri Mariamman Temple.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 35
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTaste our various cultures, from sweet to savoury, local to international, at the largest hawker centre in Singapore!\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 36
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSome of the toothsome pastries from Tong Heng include candied melon pastries, savoury buns and their signature egg tarts.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 37
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eMore than just a shopping stretch, this iconic street is home to a wide range of offerings, from lacquered fans to charming souvenirs.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 38
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBring home a traditional taste of Singapore. Bak kwa (barbequed meat slices) is a delectable dried sweet and savoury snack similar to jerky.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 39
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBeat the heat and enjoy a selection of traditional desserts from this beloved eatery. Be sure to try their snow ice and mango sago.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 40
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003ePop by this historic neighbourhood from vibrant street art to the majestic charm of the Sultan Mosque, this is a melting pot of cultures both hip and historical.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 41
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThe golden-domed Sultan Mosque — Kampong Gelam’s most striking landmark —makes for a beautiful photo opportunity at dusk.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 42
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eA bustling narrow lane adorned with colourful murals, boutique shops, and trendy cafes. Stroll through this street, known for its boutiques, cafes and buzzing nightlife.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 43
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSpend the morning amidst nature and tranquility at this UNESCO heritage site, which is filled with beautiful flora and fauna.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 44
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eDon’t miss the National Orchid Garden nestled within the Botanic Gardens, home to\u0026nbsp;the largest orchid display in the world with over 60,000 plants and orchids.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 45
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBreak for brunch - located amidst the one-hectare Ginger Garden, this restaurant specialises in contemporary European cuisine.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 46
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSwitch up the pace – head to Singapore’s major shopping district, where you’ll find a mix of high-end brands, local labels, and everything in between.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 47
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExperience a curation of over 100 homegrown fashion and lifestyle labels, the largest one-stop destination to shop all things local.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 48
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eLocated amidst the hustle and bustle of Orchard Road, take a stroll to admire the colourful Peranakan shophouses, and enjoy a pitstop at the bars.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 49
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTake a stroll down the Singapore River and experience delectable food and buzzing sights at the heart of Singapore\u0027s vibrant nightlife scene.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 50
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eFeel the adrenaline course through your veins with a thrilling ride that’ll have you careening nearly 70 metres through the air at speeds over 160 kilometres per hour.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 51
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eArt, food and music come together at Offtrack, an effortlessly cool bar that serves up Pan Asian cuisine, cocktails and live DJ sets.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 52
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eNestled in the East, with its rainbow-hued heritage shophouses, hip cafes and modern boutiques, this is one of Singapore’s most charming districts.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 53
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eIndulge in a piping hot bowl of laksa, a spicy coconut milk-based noodle soup rich in flavour, with ingredients such as prawns, cockles and bean sprouts.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 54
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eFrom stunning traditional wares and unique souvenirs, this beloved store is your one-stop shop for discovering the rich tapestry of Peranakan culture.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 55
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eShop for home decor, lifestyle items and more. Many of the goods here are designed by artists from Singapore and across Asia, making it\u0026nbsp;a great way to grab a souvenir.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 56
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThese iconic, pastel-hued houses date back to the 1920s, and provide the perfect opportunity for you to feed your social media accounts.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 57
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eLearn about the history of the Eurasian community in Singapore across the three galleries of this quaint heritage attraction.\u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003cbr /\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 58
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAn unparalleled fusion of design, architecture and lush nature, this world-class lifestyle hub is the perfect way to end your trip to Singapore.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 59
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTake a leisurely stroll through the forest and marvel at the centrepiece attraction – the world’s tallest indoor waterfall.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 60
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHead to the top floor of Jewel Changi Airport to rediscover your inner child by exploring mazes, bouncing nets, and giant slides.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 61
tiles.description: From street food to heritage dining haunts and Michelin-starred restaurants, embark on this food trail that will take your taste buds on a wild ride.

tiles.title: Highlight 62
tiles.description: Embark on a 2-day journey in Singapore, immersing yourself in a blend of cultural experiences, museum visits, attractions, through Singapore’s diverse cityscape.

tiles.description: Find new ways to relax, rejuvenate and revitalise your body and spirit during your tropical vacation to the Lion City.

tiles.description: Pressed for time? Take in some of Singapore’s most famous sights in our 24 hour guide.

tiles.description: In town for a while? Shop, eat, and play with this detailed itinerary and enjoy the best of Singapore.

tiles.title: Highlight 66
tiles.description: From unique local designers to some of the world’s largest global luxury brands, shopaholics are in for a treat.

tiles.title: Highlight 67
tiles.description: Whether you’re newly-married or on a wedding anniversary, Singapore is the perfect destination for couples in the mood for love.

tiles.title: Highlight 68
tiles.description: Explore top outdoor adventure activities in Singapore - from biking in Pulau Ubin, to kayaking along mangroves, hiking trails and luge rides. Perfect for nature lovers!

tiles.title: Highlight 69
tiles.description: What to see, food to eat, things to do, experiences that can’t be missed—here’s a guide to the best of Singapore that’s fit for all ages.

tiles.title: Highlight 70
tiles.description: Celebrate your hen party in one of the world's safest cities! Enjoy bachelorette trip ideas like spa, cocktails & nightlife for the perfect girls' getaway.

itinerary-food.name: 3-Day Singapore Food Guide & Hawker Trail
itinerary-food.title: 3-Day Singapore Food Guide

tiles.title: Chinatown Complex Food Centre
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWhere better to kick off your foodie adventure than the largest hawker centre in Singapore?\u0026nbsp;You\u0027ll be spoilt for choice, from sweet to savoury, and local to international cuisines!\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Tong Heng Traditional Cantonese Pastries
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSavour on toothsome pastries from Tong Heng, which include candied melon pastries, savoury buns and their signature egg tarts.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Zén
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBjorn Frantzén\u0027s three Michelin-starred restaurant is famed for its masterful take on Scandinavian and Japanese fusion cuisine.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Ann Siang Hill
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eEnter this buzzing street, home to exciting bars and restaurants.\u0026nbsp;There’re loads of options to pick from to sate your hunger and slake your thirst.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Hjh Maimunah Nasi Padang
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBe like a local and start your day with a mountain of rice. The\u0026nbsp;\u003ci\u003enasi padang\u003c/i\u003e\u0026nbsp;(rice with a medley of Malay dishes) served here is one of the best on the island.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Haji Lane
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eMake your way to this trendy lane for some great live music. Come nightfall, the many bars and cafés in the area set up al fresco seating areas as live musicians belt out tunes on the narrow lane.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Blanco Court Prawn Mee
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eA sinful Singaporean dish, dig into a rich prawn noodle broth served with al dente noodles and juicy prawns.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Birds of Paradise
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eDelight in refreshing and smooth gelatos with botanical inspired flavours of nature using regional herbs like basil and blue ginger.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Atlas
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eGrab refreshing cocktails\u0026nbsp;at this bar which has Gotham-like exterior and luxurious 1920s inspired interior. It is decked with intricate art and a Gin Tower with over 1,000 bottles on display.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Tekka Centre
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eLet the fragrance of spices and curries pique your appetite in the morning. The hawker centre specialises in food from across the Indian sub-continent, as well as local delights like duck rice and fish soup.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: A Noodle Story
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTaste a bowl of fusion handmade noodles at this Singapore-style ramen stall, a Michelin Bib Gourmand awardee since 2016.\u0026nbsp;Its local and international influences reflect Singapore\u0027s rich culinary heritage.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Candlenut
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eA one Michelin star restaurant, Candlenut serves up\u0026nbsp;traditional Peranakan fare with a creative twist and an Indonesian touch.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Mama Diam
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eA speakeasy bar that infuses elements of our local provision store common in the past. Explore a food and drinks menu that puts a modern twist to iconic local favourites.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r

itinerary-nature.name: Outdoor Adventure & City in Nature
itinerary-nature.title: Outdoor Adventure Activities in Singapore: Fun & Nature

tiles.title: Pulau Ubin
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eLocated on the eastern end of Singapore, hitch a bumboat ride to find rustic shrines, swamplands and scenic summits.\u003c/p\u003e\r \u003cp\u003eThis sanctuary is the perfect place for explorers looking to unwind and deepen their love for nature.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Mangrove Kayaking
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBeginner friendly, this guided tour allows you to explore the Pulau Ubin\u0027s tranquil environment and abundance of floral and fauna whilst paddling on kayaks.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Chek Jawa
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTucked away in the east of Pulau Ubin, this rich intertidal ecosystem is home to diverse wildlife. Head to the Jewawi Tower for a chance to observe birds and a panoramic view of the island.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Lazarus Island
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAs an alternative to Pulau Ubin Island, bask in the sun, sand, and sea at Lazarus Island. This hidden gem boasts relaxing beaches and abundant marine life, just a ferry ride away from the mainland.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Singapore Botanic Gardens
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eRecognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, find highlights such as National Orchid Garden, a gorgeous swan lake and heaps of tropical trees to please every plant enthusiast out there.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Bukit Timah Nature Reserve
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWhile the sun’s still out, check out this reserve to find Singapore’s highest hill, Bukit Timah Hill. Challenge yourself to a trek up its 163-metre-high slopes, on trails that wind through pockets of forested area.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Southern Ridges
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eKeep your camera on hand when you hike the photogenic ten-kilometre-long network of trails. Head to Henderson Waves, the highest pedestrian bridge in Singapore.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: MacRitchie Nature Trail and Reservoir Park
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThe highlight of this park is its Treetop Walks, a 250-metre aerial free standing suspension bridge spanning the two highest points within MacRitchie.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: AltitudeX
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExperience the world’s largest wind tunnel for indoor skydiving. State-of-the-art technology will lend you wings in an experience that simulates free falls from heights of 12,000 to 3,000 feet.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Mega Adventure Park
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBrave new heights with this adrenaline-pumping zip wire ride, where you will get to experience a whole new perspective of Sentosa\u0027s lush jungles and white beaches from 450 metres in the air.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Hydrodash
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eLocated along the waters of Palawan Beach, Singapore’s first floating aquapark is an unforgettable experience for the young and the young at heart.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Skyline Luge
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eEmbark on a thrilling journey as you zoom down thrilling courses in a 3-wheeled luge.\u003c/p\u003e\r \u003cp\u003eThe skyride also offers a magnificent bird’s eye view of the city.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Adventure Cove
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHave a splashing good time at Adventure Cove, experience thrilling water slides, snorkel with fish, and relax on the lazy river.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Gardens By the Bay
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eGardens by the Bay is a stunning park consisting of three waterfront gardens. Discover rare flowers, Supertrees, and intriguing sculptures from all over the world.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Trifecta
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSurf, snow and skate in one destination! This integrated facility in Orchard Road will offer a wave of excitement for both beginners and seasoned professionals.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Climb Central Funan
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAscend to new heights with rock climbing located in the centre of this trendy mall. Pick between high intensity short climbs or scale the many high walls.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Slingshot
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThis thrilling ride catapults you\u0026nbsp;nearly 70 metres up in the air, at speeds of over 160 kilometres per hour. Enjoy the breezy nightscape of the Singapore River while screaming at the top of your lungs!\u003c/p\u003e\r

itinerary-family.name: Family Fun Itinerary
itinerary-family.title: Singapore Family & Kids Trip

tiles.title: Singapore DuckTours
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSpend your first day in Singapore sampling all that our city has to offer with this hop-on and hop-off ride. Some highlights include Little India, Orchard Road and Chinatown.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: National Gallery
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eVisit the world\u0027s largest public display of modern Southeast Asian art. Stroller friendly, it also houses the Keppel Centre for Art Education, a children-centric learning zone that revolves around the themes of art and wonder.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: ArtScience Museum
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThis beloved lotus-inspired establishment blurs the lines between art, science, culture and technology, with exciting hands-on and interactive exhibitions on rotation that are perfect for children.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Singapore River Cruise
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThen, make your way to a traditional bumboat. Let your guide engage the whole family in a captivating tale of Singapore’s two famous quays—Boat Quay and Clarke Quay—and take in the scenic views.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Children’s Museum
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eGot little ones in tow? Don’t miss the Children’s Museum Singapore! It is interactive, playful, and totally worth the visit if you’ve got energetic kids who love to explore.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Sentosa
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSpend the whole day at Sentosa, a playground for the whole family. There’s something for everyone on this island at Southern Singapore, including a giant floating water park - Hydrodash, with designated zones for kids.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Universal Studios Singapore
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThis movie-themed entertainment park is peppered with thrilling rides based on blockbuster flicks like Transformers and Jurassic Park.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Skyline Luge
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eFeel your adrenaline pumping while riding this 3-wheeled luge carts down windy tracks, that\u0027s great for both the young and young at heart.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Kiztopia Prestige
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHead to Kiztopia Prestige in River Valley, a premium play space made just for your little ones! Discover fun play zones with soft play areas and interactive programs in a safe environment.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Science Centre
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eExplore a world of discovery at Science Centre Singapore, where hands-on exhibits, imaginative play at KidsSTOP™, and immersive 8K 3D dome experiences at the Omni-Theatre inspire curious minds of all ages to learn and imagine.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Singapore Botanic Gardens
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTake a stroll at Singapore’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site. Check out highlights like the Swan Lake and National Orchid Garden, which is home to the world’s largest display of orchids.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Jacob Ballas Children\u0027s Gardens
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThe first garden in Asia dedicated to children, this park allows children to explore, play and have an adventure, while learning and cultivating a love for nature.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Dempsey
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWithin the greenery of the Dempsey neighbourhood, you will find great spots for families to unwind - like PS. Cafe, which offers Modern European creations, and the Museum of Ice Cream, where children two and under can enter for free.\u003cbr\u003e\r \u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Orchard Road
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHead over to Orchard Road, a world-famous shopping district. The area is home to family-friendly shopping malls, Paragon and Ngee Ann City, with plenty of shopping for both children and adults.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Singapore Zoo
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eObserve animals in their natural habits at the Singapore Zoo. Indulge in a hearty Breakfast in the Wild, which will have you dining alongside Orangutans and Macaws, perfect for all animal lovers.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Bird Paradise
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003ePop by adjacent Bird Paradise, home to over 3,500 birds, with highlights including walk through aviaries that reflect habitats across the world.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: River Wonders
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAlternatively, head to a river-themed zoo and aquarium to find animals like the Giant Panda, Brazilian Tapirs and Capybara.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Night Safari
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAs dusk falls, head to the Night Safari for a world of nocturnal creatures. Explore the park on a Safari Tram Adventure or head to the walking trails to see the animals up close.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Highlight 19
tiles.description: From street food to heritage dining haunts and Michelin-starred restaurants, embark on this food trail that will take your taste buds on a wild ride.

tiles.title: Highlight 20
tiles.description: Embark on a 2-day journey in Singapore, immersing yourself in a blend of cultural experiences, museum visits, attractions, through Singapore’s diverse cityscape.

tiles.title: Highlight 21
tiles.description: Find new ways to relax, rejuvenate and revitalise your body and spirit during your tropical vacation to the Lion City.

tiles.title: Highlight 22
tiles.description: Pressed for time? Take in some of Singapore’s most famous sights in our 24 hour guide.

tiles.title: Highlight 23
tiles.description: In town for a while? Shop, eat, and play with this detailed itinerary and enjoy the best of Singapore.

tiles.title: Highlight 24
tiles.description: With a week to spare, discover how East meets West, nature and urban beauty intertwine, and the past meets present, with our guide to Singapore's most iconic spots.

tiles.title: Highlight 25
tiles.description: From unique local designers to some of the world’s largest global luxury brands, shopaholics are in for a treat.

tiles.title: Highlight 26
tiles.description: Whether you’re newly-married or on a wedding anniversary, Singapore is the perfect destination for couples in the mood for love.

tiles.title: Highlight 27
tiles.description: Explore top outdoor adventure activities in Singapore - from biking in Pulau Ubin, to kayaking along mangroves, hiking trails and luge rides. Perfect for nature lovers!

tiles.title: Highlight 28
tiles.description: Celebrate your hen party in one of the world's safest cities! Enjoy bachelorette trip ideas like spa, cocktails & nightlife for the perfect girls' getaway.

tiles.title: Highlight 29
tiles.description: Planning a Singapore solo trip opens up a world of freedom and discovery. Wander heritage neighbourhoods on your own, pause for reflection in tranquil gardens, or treat yourself to a Michelin-starred meal.

local-delights.title: Experience Local Singapore Hawker Food & Street Food

tiles.title: Amoy Street Market
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWith a name that means \u0027little rebel\u0027 in Chinese, this restaurant serves up playful renditions of fusion fare, and local classics with an elevated twist. \u003ci\u003eSatay\u003c/i\u003e made with Angus Beef and Roast Duck flavoured with truffle are just some highlights on its colourful menu.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Maxwell Food Centre
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHoused in a traditional Chinese shophouse, this restaurant and cocktail bar pays homage to Singapore’s rich history with its reinterpretation of classic dishes and cocktails with a Singaporean flavour.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Chinatown Complex Food Centre
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBorn from a humble hawker stall in 1992, Harummanis has evolved into a culinary journey led by Akmal Anuar. Honouring his parents\u0027 30 year legacy, Akmal puts a modern touch on traditional Malay food.\u003c/p\u003e\r

contentLines: Experience Local Singapore Hawker Food & Street Food

travel-sustainably.name: Travel Sustainably in Singapore
travel-sustainably.title: Explore Sustainable and Responsible Travel in Singapore

tiles.title: GINLEE Studio
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSustainability is at the heart of this brand\u0027s philosophy, with designs made from sustainable fabrics like Tencel and hands-on workshops to redesign customers\u0027 old apparel.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Studio Gypsied
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eSlow fashion is the byword with this brand, with sustainably sourced batik that\u0027s made-to-order by traditional artisans from marginalised communities.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Esse
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTimeless design and sustainability harmonise at Esse, with designs made from organic and renewable fabrics.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: The Green Collective
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eA curation of sustainable brands, The Green Collective sells everything from candles to food and fashion, and also hosts sustainable workshops.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: The Sustainability Project
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eMore than just a store, this retail brand is a movement. You\u0027ll find sustainable items like straws and cutlery, but also workshops and zero waste initiatives.\u003c/p\u003e\r \u003cp\u003e\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Fysh
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eHelmed by Josh Niland, FYSH brings a revolutionary, sustainable approach to whole fish cooking. Using the finest ingredients, each dish celebrates often-overlooked components for a unique and responsible dining experience.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Restaurant Air CCCC
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eAIR redefines sustainable dining with its holistic Awareness, Impact and Responsibility ethos. Nestled in Dempsey Hill, it combines farm-to-table produce with an innovative approach for a mindful culinary experience.\u0026nbsp;\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Scaled by Ah Hua Kelong
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTaste the freshness of the sea\u0027s bounty at Scaled, which sources its seafood from local farmers, instead of seafood imported from overseas.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Laurus Table
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eLaurus Table marries the elegance of Italy’s Amalfi Coast with Singapore’s coastal bounty. Savour fresh seafood and sustainably farmed fish, complemented by organic produce and herbs handpicked from The Laurus’s own garden.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Level 33
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eRevel in artisanal beer, fine dining and stunning views at the world\u0027s highest microbrewery. Serving sustainably produced beers and incorporating brewing byproducts into its dishes, each mouthful is a delight to the senses and planet.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Kaarla and Oumi @1-Arden
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eBoth sister restaurants source\u0026nbsp;sustainable produce from local farms and right outside their doorstep, at the 10,000 square foot 1-Arden Food Forest.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Seroja
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eWinner of the Michelin Green Star, this restaurant foregrounds dishes from the Malay Archipelago, with local seafood, produce and spices.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Ugly Food Tour Through Jalan Besar (Sinful Bites and Bright Lights)
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eMinimise your carbon footprint by hoofing it on a walking tour, as you learn about Jalan Besar\u0027s colourful history and delicious hawker fare.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Sentosa Intertidal Exploration
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eGet inspired to do\u0026nbsp;your\u003cb\u003e\u0026nbsp;\u003c/b\u003epart for the planet\u0026nbsp;by admiring the intricate ecosystems and habitats on the sunny island of Sentosa.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Culture, Art and Architecture Private Tour
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eTake a walk down memory lane and learn how local artists depicted Singapore, as you explore Chinatown and the heart of the city.\u003c/p\u003e\r

tiles.title: Historical Singapore Bicycle Tour
tiles.description: \u003cp\u003eThis eco-friendly bike tour will take you on a meandering ride down the Singapore River, as you discover mosques, museums and other fascinating landmarks.\u003c/p\u003e\r

You are eligible for a GST refund if you are a tourist. Other criteria you have to meet: \r \r You are a  visitor aged 16 or older on the date of purchase. \r \r You are not a Singapore Citizen or Permanent Resident. \r \r You are not a crew member of the aircraft on which you are leaving Singapore. \r \r You do not hold any work, student, dependent or long-term pass. \r \r You must spend at least SGD $100 (including GST) in one store (or up to 3 same-day receipts from the same store). \r \r You must purchase from a participating "Tax Free" store in the Tourism Refund Scheme. \r \r You must leave Singapore from  Changi International Airport or Seletar Airport with your goods within 2 months of purchase. \r \r \r For more information on the GST refund eligibility criteria, please head here . \r "}]}">

You cannot claim tax refunds on: \r \r Goods that you have already used or consumed in Singapore. \r \r Goods that you are exporting for commercial purposes. \r \r Goods that will be exported by freight. \r \r Services that you have already used or consumed in Singapore (e.g. tours, car rentals). \r \r Accommodation in a hotel or hostel, or similar establishments. \r \r \r "},{"question_t":"How much GST refund am I entitled to?","answer_t":" \r The GST rate in Singapore is 9%, but the actual amount refunded to you will be slightly less than the GST you have paid on your purchase.  \r \r This is due to handling fees deducted by the retailer/central refund agency/operator of the central refund counter. \r \r To check your transaction details, register and log in at  https://touristrefund.sg to view your submitted transactions, refund amounts, and refund status. \r \r \r "}]}">

The eTRS is Singapore's digital refund system for tourist shopping. It is a seamless and hassle-free way for tourists to seek refunds for the 9% GST paid on purchases made in Singapore. \r "},{"question_t":"How can I claim my GST refund?","answer_t":" You can claim your tax refund in a few simple steps for purchases made at establishments displaying the “Global Blue” or “Global Tax Free” logo. \r   \r \r At the Shop \r - Spend S$100 or more (including GST) in one store, or over up to 3 same-day receipts from the same retailer. \r - Show your passport and electronic Visit Pass ( e-Pass)* , so the purchase is recorded under your name in the Electronic Tourist Refund Scheme (eTRS) . \r - You should have received your e-Pass upon clearing immigration after you arrive in Singapore. \r   \r \r At the Airport \r - When departing, arrive at the airport early to allow sufficient time to process your GST refund and for the inspection of goods (if required). \r - Before clearing immigration, visit an eTRS self-help kiosk at Changi International Airport or Seletar Airport to review your purchases, check your estimated refund amount, and submit your claim. \r - Scan your passport  to validate your tax-free transactions. \r - Choose the items you are bringing out of Singapore. \r - Choose how you want to be refunded. Options include cash, credit card and Alipay. \r \r \r   \r Once your refund request is approved, the refund will usually be processed immediately (cash or Alipay) or within 10 days (credit card). \r "}]}">

\r Retailers may offer tax refunds under the TRS or eTRS network with either of the two Central Refund Agencies in Singapore - Global Blue Singapore and Global Tax Free, or on their own. \r \r Participating retailers that are affiliated with either of these two refund agencies will display one of these logos in their shops. \r \r \r \r \r If you do not see these signs, ask the staff whether the store is part of the TRS or eTRS network before making your purchase. \r \r Major department stores and shopping malls in popular areas like Orchard Road, Marina Bay Sands, and Jewel Changi Airport tend to participate in the scheme. \r \r \r "}]}">
